notes: 'above' moved from עָלָיו to the bare accusative הַכְּרֻבִים: the suffix refers to the ark, and the ASV's margin ('whereupon is called the Name') shows עָלָיו was read with נִקְרָא and dissolved into the relative. עַל and its suffix are therefore unrepresented.
'even' marked added under rule 16 because the second שֵׁם carries no marker.
